abstract.text: A comprehensive collection of standard SI and imperial units of measurement.

inlineContent.text: provides 150+ commonly-used units organized into the following categories:
: meter, kilometer, centimeter, foot, inch, mile, etc.
: kilogram, gram, pound, ounce, stone, etc.
: second, minute, hour, day, week, year, millisecond, etc.
: square meter, square kilometer, acre, hectare, etc.
: cubic meter, liter, milliliter, gallon, cup, tablespoon, etc.
: byte, kilobyte, megabyte, gigabyte (decimal and binary)
: pascal, bar, atmosphere, psi, torr, etc.
: joule, calorie, kilocalorie, watt-hour, BTU, etc.
All units are defined relative to their base SI unit for the dimension
Temperature units properly handle offset conversions (0°C = 32°F)
Data storage units include both decimal (KB, MB, GB) and binary (KiB, MiB, GiB) variants
